title: Rename the duplicate top-level incomingTutorGrantsProvider defined in both tutor_grant_providers.dart and manage_tutors_providers.dart
why: Two independent top-level providers are both named `incomingTutorGrantsProvider`: the @riverpod codegen one (network-only, no offline reconciliation) and the manual FutureProvider in manage_tutors_providers.dart (offline-first, wipes stale mirrors, the one every tutoring screen actually watches). accept_invite_screen.dart's own comment documents that this ambiguity already caused a real shipped bug ('SEV-2... otherwise the accepted row never flips in-session') and had to alias-import one of them to disambiguate/compile. The feature barrel (tutoring.dart) exports the codegen one, not the offline-first one — so any new file that imports the barrel per Rule 2 and calls `incomingTutorGrantsProvider` gets the version without offline reconciliation, silently reintroducing the same bug class.
recommendation: Rename one of the two providers (e.g. manage_tutors_providers.dart's to `offlineFirstIncomingTutorGrantsProvider` or fold the offline-first logic into the codegen provider and delete the duplicate), and update the barrel to export only the real one actually used by the screens.
acceptance_criteria: Only one top-level symbol named incomingTutorGrantsProvider exists under lib/features/tutoring/.
accept_invite_screen.dart's `as manage_tutors` alias workaround is no longer needed for a naming collision.
grep -rn 'incomingTutorGrantsProvider' lib/features/tutoring/ shows exactly one definition.

corrections: The finding's quoted phrase "SEV-2... otherwise the accepted row never flips in-session" splices the SEV-2 tag (accept_invite_screen.dart:172, about invalidation timing) with "otherwise the accepted row never flips in-session" which actually appears in the earlier import-disambiguation comment (~lines 33-39) explaining why manage_tutors_providers must be used instead of the codegen one. Both comments are real and both support the finding's claim, but they are not one contiguous quote.
